master_experiments_summary.What_It_Tests: Disentangles spatial pooling from sequence order ($H_3$)
Temporal context robustness under data loss ($H_4$)

master_experiments_summary.Statistical_Evidence: Remains superior to clean baseline (+12.55 pp)

master_experiments_summary.What_It_Tests: Temporal resolution threshold & action taxonomy ($H_1, H_3$)

hypothesis_mapping_summary.Core_Premise: Additional sequential visual evidence resolves ambiguous frame-level states.
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Empirical_Evidence: Accuracy grows monotonically from 11.56% ($K=1$) to 34.78% ($K=8$) (+23.22 pp gain, $p < 10^{-12}$).

hypothesis_mapping_summary.Core_Premise: Physical transformations (e.g., Opening vs Closing) require strict temporal ordering.
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Supporting_Experiment: Exp B (Temporal Shuffle) & Exp G (Temporal Reversal)
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Empirical_Evidence: Shuffling causes a -13.89 pp collapse ($p = 2.99 \times 10^{-11}$). Reversal causes a -20.00 pp drop with 42.7% prediction flips.

hypothesis_mapping_summary.Hypothesis: H3: Temporal modeling adds value over pooling
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Core_Premise: Performance gains stem from temporal dynamics, not mere multi-frame spatial accumulation or capacity.
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Supporting_Experiment: Exp C (MeanPool Control) & Exp D (CompactGRU Parity)
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Empirical_Evidence: MeanPool achieves 8.22% (-0.56 pp vs baseline). CompactGRU at exact 103,700 capacity achieves 23.56% (+15.33 pp over MeanPool, $p = 1.16 \times 10^{-4}$).

hypothesis_mapping_summary.Core_Premise: Recurrent state representations buffer against corrupted or missing observations.
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Supporting_Experiment: Exp E (Frame Drops) & Exp F (Gaussian Noise)
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Empirical_Evidence: Under 50% missing data (4/8 frames dropped), GRU retains 21.44% accuracy (2.4x higher than clean baseline). Under severe noise ($\sigma=0.5$), GRU retains 21.33%.

hypothesis_mapping_summary.Core_Premise: Marginal utility of additional frames diminishes as physical action transition completes.
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Supporting_Experiment: Exp A (Progressive Curve Derivative) & Exp H (Horizon $K^*$)
hypothesis_mapping_summary.Empirical_Evidence: Growth slows from +11.78 pp ($K=2 \to 4$) to +5.44 pp ($K=4 \to 8$). 49.0% of all resolvable sequences are fully resolved by $K=8$.

falsification_verdicts.Falsification_Condition: Increasing frame count produces no meaningful improvement ($\Delta K \le 1$ pp).
Shuffling produces essentially no degradation in the temporal model ($\Delta_{\text{order}} \le 2$ pp).
GRU performs similarly to or worse than order-invariant mean pooling ($\Delta_{\text{parity}} \le 0$ pp).
falsification_verdicts.Observed_Outcome: CompactGRU outperforms MeanPool by +15.33 pp ($p = 1.16 \times 10^{-4}$); Full GRU outperforms by +26.56 pp ($p < 10^{-12}$).

falsification_verdicts.Falsification_Condition: Temporal context does not reduce degradation under corruption (relative drop $\ge$ baseline).
falsification_verdicts.Observed_Outcome: GRU retains 61.6% capacity under 50% frame loss, maintaining 2.4x higher accuracy than clean single-frame baseline.

falsification_verdicts.Falsification_Condition: Performance continues improving linearly without diminishing returns across all frame counts.
falsification_verdicts.Observed_Outcome: Marginal gain decays sharply (+11.78 pp from $K=2 \to 4$ down to +5.44 pp from $K=4 \to 8$).

confounds_elimination.Risk_Description: Higher frame models or recurrent networks win purely from parameter capacity rather than temporal reasoning.
confounds_elimination.Elimination_Control: Implemented Model D (CompactTemporalGRU) with exact 103,700 parameters matching Model A and Model B.
confounds_elimination.Audit_Status: CERTIFIED ELIMINATED (+15.33 pp gain over MeanPool at identical parameter count)

confounds_elimination.Risk_Description: Comparing different parts of sequences (e.g. K=1 first frame vs K=4 last frames) introduces position confounds.
confounds_elimination.Elimination_Control: Symmetric uniform coverage: K=1 anchor at center (t=4), K in {2, 4, 8} uniformly spaced across the identical 8-frame sequence.
confounds_elimination.Audit_Status: CERTIFIED ELIMINATED (Sampling policy frozen in configs/experimental_controls.yaml)

confounds_elimination.Risk_Description: Temporally contiguous clips or identical actors shared between train and test splits artificially inflate accuracy.
confounds_elimination.Elimination_Control: Group-aware partition on unique video IDs; 0 frame leakage between train (1400), val (300), and test (300).
confounds_elimination.Audit_Status: CERTIFIED ELIMINATED (Audited by leakage-guard and verify_m3_exit_gate.py)

confounds_elimination.Risk_Description: Modifying hyperparameters, architectures, or sampling after inspecting test performance.
confounds_elimination.Elimination_Control: Model selection strictly governed by validation EarlyStopping (patience=5); test set untouched until evaluation.
confounds_elimination.Audit_Status: CERTIFIED ELIMINATED (Best validation checkpoints restored prior to test inference)
